description: Trading rules — three sections: TIERS + ENTRY RULES per asset class + RISK RULES universal. Updated with Ross Cameron (Warrior Trading) strategies.
architecture: Section 0 = Trade TIERS (scalping vs swing). Section 1 = WHEN to enter (per asset). Section 2 = HOW MUCH to risk and WHEN to exit (all assets).

section_0_tiers.description: Two tiers of trades. Tier 1 is for future automation (Bitget scalper). Tier 2 is what Maria places manually now.

tier_1_scalping.label: TIER 1 — AUTOMATION ONLY — do not place manually
tier_1_scalping.purpose: Future automated execution via Bitget API (scalper-run.js or similar)
tier_1_scalping.stop_loss: Very tight — a few pips from entry
tier_1_scalping.execution: NOT manual. Will be automated once Bitget system is ready.

eligible_assets.stocks: High-liquidity only: NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, META, GOOGL, AMZN

tier_1_scalping.briefing_format: Brief overview table only. No full trade cards.

tier_2_swing.label: TIER 2 — PLACE MANUALLY
tier_2_swing.purpose: Manual placement by Maria in TradingView paper trading
tier_2_swing.stop_loss: Medium — based on clear support/resistance levels
tier_2_swing.execution: Manual — Maria places limit orders with stop and target

eligible_assets.crypto: BTC, ETH, SOL, FET, RENDER, TAO on 4H-Daily charts

tier_2_swing.briefing_format: Full trade cards with Entry, Stop, Target, R:R, Units, Alerts, Why.

forex.character: Session-driven, macro/news sensitive, highest liquidity of any market

strategies.name: London Session Breakout
strategies.when_to_use: Price ranging overnight, London open creates directional break
strategies.entry_long: Price breaks ABOVE previous day high at London open (10:00-11:00 Oslo) with EMA 20 pointing up
strategies.entry_short: Price breaks BELOW previous day low at London open with EMA 20 pointing down
strategies.avoid: NFP, CPI, Fed decisions — no trade 30min either side

strategies.name: EMA 8/21 Crossover + RSI Filter
strategies.when_to_use: Trending markets. Best when macro direction is clear.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 8 crosses ABOVE EMA 21 AND RSI > 50 AND price above both EMAs
strategies.entry_short: EMA 8 crosses BELOW EMA 21 AND RSI < 50
strategies.stop_loss: Behind most recent swing high (shorts) or swing low (longs)
strategies.confluence_check: Align with macro trend — check ECB vs Fed policy direction

strategies.name: Pin Bar Reversal at Key Levels
strategies.when_to_use: Price reaches well-established support/resistance and shows rejection candle
strategies.entry_long: Pin bar (long lower wick) forms AT key support level
strategies.entry_short: Pin bar (long upper wick) forms AT key resistance level
strategies.stop_loss: Just beyond the tail of the pin bar
strategies.notes: Pure price action. High probability only when aligned with trend.

best_sessions_oslo.avoid: 30min before/after earnings releases and Fed decisions

strategies.name: EMA 50/200 Trend + RSI Pullback
strategies.when_to_use: Outside earnings season. Index in clear uptrend above EMA 200.
strategies.entry_long: Price above EMA 200 AND EMA 50 > EMA 200 AND RSI pulls back to 40-50 — enter on bounce
strategies.entry_short: Price below EMA 200 AND RSI bounces to 50-60 — enter on rejection
strategies.earnings_rule: EXIT all positions 2 days before earnings season begins

strategies.name: Triple Screen — Weekly Trend + Daily MACD
strategies.when_to_use: Align daily trade with weekly trend picture
strategies.entry_long: Weekly trend up (price > EMA 13 weekly) AND Daily MACD histogram turns positive
strategies.entry_short: Weekly trend down AND Daily MACD histogram turns negative
strategies.stop_loss: Below most recent daily swing low
strategies.take_profit: At resistance or when weekly trend weakens
strategies.notes: Never trade against the weekly trend. Elder first rule.

earnings_season_special.name: Post-Earnings Gap Trading
earnings_season_special.when_to_use: ONLY during earnings season (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct). Individual stocks only.
earnings_season_special.entry_rule: Wait for earnings release. Gap UP > 3% on high volume — enter LONG within first 30 minutes
earnings_season_special.risk_reduction: Use HALF normal position size — earnings are binary events
earnings_season_special.avoid: Never enter BEFORE earnings are released

commodities.character: Macro-driven by USD strength, inflation, geopolitics, OPEC

best_sessions_oslo.gold_silver: 10:00 Oslo (London) and 15:30 Oslo (NY) — two peak windows
best_sessions_oslo.oil: 15:30 Oslo (NY open). OPEC news typically 12:00-14:00 Oslo

strategies.name: Gold vs USD Inverse Correlation
strategies.when_to_use: When USD has clear directional trend from Fed policy
strategies.entry_long: DXY falling (USD weakening) AND Gold above EMA 50
strategies.entry_short: DXY rising (USD strengthening) AND Gold below EMA 50
strategies.macro_check: Always check DXY before trading Gold. They move opposite 80% of the time.

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout
strategies.when_to_use: After period of low volatility — bands visibly narrow on chart
strategies.entry_long: Bands squeeze then price breaks ABOVE upper band with above-average volume
strategies.entry_short: Bands squeeze then price breaks BELOW lower band with above-average volume
strategies.take_profit: 2x the Bollinger Band width at time of breakout

strategies.name: Oil EMA Trend + OPEC News Filter
strategies.source: Energy commodity traders and macro analysts
strategies.when_to_use: When OPEC stance is known and no meeting is imminent
strategies.entry_long: EMA 20 > EMA 50 AND no major OPEC supply increase expected within 2 weeks
strategies.entry_short: EMA 20 < EMA 50 OR OPEC announces production increase
strategies.override_rule: OPEC surprise announcement — EXIT immediately regardless of position

crypto.character: 24/7 market, high volatility, sentiment-driven, follows BTC dominance cycle

best_sessions_oslo.avoid: Weekend trading — low volume, wider spreads, erratic moves
best_sessions_oslo.note: Crypto never closes but signal quality is lower on weekends

crypto.btc_dominance_rule: Check BTC.D before altcoins. BTC dominance RISING = avoid altcoins. FALLING = altcoins outperform.

strategies.name: Golden Cross / Death Cross
strategies.source: Institutional traders — most followed BTC macro signal
strategies.when_to_use: Weekly chart only. Identifying major bull or bear cycles.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 50 crosses ABOVE EMA 200 — Golden Cross, major bull signal
strategies.entry_short: EMA 50 crosses BELOW EMA 200 — Death Cross, major bear signal
strategies.stop_loss: Below most recent weekly swing low
strategies.notes: Slow high-conviction signal. Do not use on daily — too many false signals.

strategies.name: EMA 21/55 + RSI Trend Filter
strategies.source: Raoul Pal, Michael van de Poppe
strategies.when_to_use: Daily chart. BTC in defined trend and RSI confirms momentum.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 21 crosses ABOVE EMA 55 AND RSI > 50
strategies.entry_short: EMA 21 crosses BELOW EMA 55 AND RSI < 50

strategies.name: MACD + Volume Breakout (Altcoins)
strategies.when_to_use: BTC dominance flat or falling AND altcoin shows MACD momentum with volume
strategies.entry_long: MACD line crosses ABOVE signal line AND volume > 20-period average
strategies.entry_short: MACD crosses BELOW signal line AND volume spike on red candle
strategies.stop_loss: Below breakout level or -5% from entry — whichever is closer
strategies.risk_note: Altcoins more volatile than BTC — use HALF normal position size

us_stocks_daytrading.assets: US small-cap and mid-cap stocks — selected dynamically each morning via scanners
us_stocks_daytrading.character: Momentum-driven, news-catalyzed, high relative volume, intraday only
us_stocks_daytrading.source: Ross Cameron (Warrior Trading) — $583 to $10M+ verified and audited

best_sessions_oslo.primary: 15:30-16:30 Oslo (US market open — first hour is where 80%+ of profit comes from)
best_sessions_oslo.avoid: After 18:00 Oslo (liquidity drops, decision fatigue increases)

stock_selection_criteria.description: Five criteria for finding momentum stocks each morning. Grade as A (all 5), B (4/5), C (3/5). Only trade A-quality in cold markets.
stock_selection_criteria.criterion_2: Relative Volume 5x or higher vs 50-day average
stock_selection_criteria.criterion_3: Price between $2 and $20 (sweet spot for percentage returns)
stock_selection_criteria.criterion_4: Float under 10 million shares (low supply = bigger moves)
stock_selection_criteria.criterion_5: News catalyst present (earnings, FDA, contract, clinical trial)

strategies.name: Bull Flag / Micro Pullback (Momentum Day Trade)
strategies.when_to_use: Stock gaps up on news, squeezes on first candles, then pulls back 2-4 candles with decreasing volume
strategies.multi_timeframe: Daily (check 200 EMA/SMA), 5-min (check extension from 9 EMA), 1-min (MACD + entry), 10-sec (precision entries)
strategies.entry_long: First candle to make new high after 2-4 candle pullback with decreasing volume. Stock must hold above 50% retracement. MACD must be above signal line (window open). Price above VWAP.
strategies.entry_short: Not primary — Ross focuses on long momentum trades
strategies.stop_loss: Low of the pullback candle — set BEFORE entry, never moved against you
strategies.take_profit: Retest of high of day (most reliable target). Or 2:1 to 3:1 R:R.
strategies.macd_window_rule: MACD above signal = window OPEN (trades allowed). MACD below signal = window CLOSED (no trades). After MACD crossover down, STOP trading that stock entirely.
strategies.front_side_rule: Only trade first spike + first 2 pullbacks. Avoid 3rd pullback and beyond — probability drops significantly.
strategies.adding_to_winners: When trade moves in your favor, double position and move stop to breakeven. Turns $2K winner into $6K with zero additional risk. NEVER add to losers.

strategies.name: VWAP Reclaim Reversal
strategies.when_to_use: Stock sold off below VWAP, then reclaims above VWAP with volume
strategies.entry_long: Price crosses back above VWAP with above-average volume. 9 EMA turning up.
strategies.take_profit: Next resistance level or high of day

strategies.name: Moving Average Bounce (9 EMA Dip Buy)
strategies.when_to_use: Stock in strong uptrend, pulling back to 9 EMA on 1-min or 5-min chart
strategies.entry_long: Price touches or dips slightly below 9 EMA and bounces. MACD still above signal line. Volume decreasing on pullback.
strategies.stop_loss: Below 20 EMA — if price breaks both 9 and 20, trend is weakening
strategies.take_profit: New high or previous resistance level

bullish: Dragonfly doji at pullback low — buyers overwhelming sellers
Bottoming tail (long lower wick on red candle) — buyers rallying
Hammer at 9 EMA support — bounce expected
bearish_exit: Large upper wick / shooting star — exhaustion, exit or do not enter
High-volume red candle — significant selling, tighten stop or exit
Inverted hammer at resistance — sellers present

key_indicators_settings.ema_9: Exponential, period 9 — primary intraday support, buy dips here
key_indicators_settings.ema_20: Exponential, period 20 — secondary support if 9 breaks
key_indicators_settings.ema_200: Exponential, period 200 — major daily support/resistance (professionals use this)
key_indicators_settings.sma_200: Simple, period 200 — plot as dotted line on daily chart (beginners/meme traders respect this)
key_indicators_settings.macd: 12, 26, 9 — NEVER change from default. Use standard so you see same signals as everyone else.
key_indicators_settings.vwap: Default volume-weighted average price — intraday only, not available on daily
key_indicators_settings.volume: Default — confirm breakouts, spot exhaustion on red candles

portfolio_risk_management.description: Portfolio-based risk management — replaces fixed trade count limits
portfolio_risk_management.read_balance: At the start of every morning briefing, read total portfolio value from TradingView paper trading account balance
portfolio_risk_management.max_total_risk: 5% of total portfolio value across ALL open trades at any time
portfolio_risk_management.position_size_formula: Position size = (portfolio value × 1%) ÷ (entry price - stop loss price)
portfolio_risk_management.no_fixed_trade_limit: Never use a fixed number of trades as the limit — use portfolio % only
portfolio_risk_management.remaining_capacity: If total risk across open trades is below 5%, new trades can be added
portfolio_risk_management.trade_replacement: If a new trade opportunity scores higher than an existing open trade, recommend cancelling the weaker trade and replacing it with the stronger one

trade_scoring.description: Rank every trade opportunity on these 5 criteria. Always show ranking in briefing.

criteria.1_risk_reward: Risk/Reward ratio — higher is better, minimum 1:2. Score: 1:2=1pt, 1:3=2pts, 1:4+=3pts
criteria.2_catalyst_strength: Earnings, geopolitical event, major news = high score. Score: none=0pts, minor=1pt, major=2pts, earnings/FOMC=3pts
criteria.3_trend_clarity: Is the direction obvious on the daily chart? Score: choppy=0pts, weak trend=1pt, clear trend=2pts, strong trend=3pts
criteria.4_session_timing: Is this the right time of day for this asset? Score: wrong session=0pts, ok=1pt, optimal session=2pts
criteria.5_strategy_match: Does it cleanly match a strategy from rules.json? Score: partial=1pt, clean match=2pts

trade_scoring.ranking: Present ALL opportunities ranked by score — highest first

swing_opportunity_bonus.description: Extra scoring points for swing trade setups — added on top of base score
swing_opportunity_bonus.support_resistance_bounce: +2 points if trade has a clear support or resistance bounce
swing_opportunity_bonus.overnight_move_gt_1pct: +2 points if overnight move was greater than 1%
swing_opportunity_bonus.volume_confirmation: +1 point if volume confirms the move
swing_opportunity_bonus.comparison_rule: Always compare swing opportunity score against open trades — if higher, recommend swapping the weakest open trade

swing_trade_monitoring.description: Track swing levels for every watchlist asset. Never let a major swing go unnoticed — catching these swings is a priority.

tracking_rules.for_every_asset: Track key swing levels: strong support, strong resistance, last major swing high, last major swing low
tracking_rules.overnight_monitoring: During morning briefing, check what happened overnight for every asset
tracking_rules.flag_threshold: If an asset moved more than 1% overnight, flag it immediately as a SWING ALERT

briefing_swing_alert_section.description: Every morning briefing must include a SWING ALERT section for each flagged asset
briefing_swing_alert_section.show_overnight_range: The overnight price range (high to low)
briefing_swing_alert_section.show_significant_swing: Any significant swing that occurred overnight
briefing_swing_alert_section.show_next_opportunity: The next swing opportunity — entry, stop loss, take profit, risk/reward
briefing_swing_alert_section.compare_vs_open: Whether this swing is better than any currently open trade

key_swing_levels_gold.support_rule: Buy every time price touches $4,644 or $4,700 support
key_swing_levels_gold.resistance_break_rule: If price breaks above $4,750, $4,800, or $4,858 resistance — Buy continuation opportunity
key_swing_levels_gold.drop_to_support: If price drops to support → immediate Buy opportunity

briefing_rules.description: Rules for the morning briefing output
briefing_rules.step_1: Read watchlist.json for the full asset list
briefing_rules.step_2: Read today.json to check existing open trades and their current risk
briefing_rules.step_3: Calculate total portfolio % currently at risk across all open trades
briefing_rules.step_4: Show remaining risk capacity (5% - current risk %) before suggesting new trades
briefing_rules.step_5: Present ALL new opportunities ranked by trade score — highest first
briefing_rules.step_6: For each new opportunity, clearly state if it scores higher than any existing open trade
briefing_rules.step_7: If yes — recommend which open trade to cancel and why

position_sizing.description: How much to risk on every trade — regardless of asset class
position_sizing.crypto_altcoin_max_risk: 0.5-1% only — higher volatility demands smaller size
position_sizing.max_portfolio_heat: 6% maximum across ALL open trades simultaneously

profit_cushion_system.source: Ross Cameron — produced 76 consecutive green days
profit_cushion_system.step_1: Start each day at 1/4 of full position size
profit_cushion_system.step_2: Only size up to full position after reaching 1/4 of daily profit goal
profit_cushion_system.step_3: If you never reach 1/4 goal, stay at 1/4 size all day
profit_cushion_system.step_4: If you give back your cushion after sizing up, drop back to 1/4 or stop entirely

adding_to_winners.rule: When trade moves in your favor, double position and move stop to breakeven
adding_to_winners.result: Turns a $2K winner into $6K with zero additional risk
adding_to_winners.average_winner_size_vs_loser: Winners should be larger positions than losers (16K shares avg winner vs 9.5K avg loser)

performance_based_sizing.description: Adjust position SIZE based on recent performance — never adjust stop DISTANCE. The stop always respects ATR. What changes is how much money you risk.

rules.winning_streak: Last 3 trades net R is positive → risk 1% per trade (full size)
rules.neutral: Last 3 trades net R is flat → risk 0.75% per trade
rules.losing_streak: Last 3 trades net R is negative → risk 0.5% per trade (half size)
rules.heavy_losing: Last 5 trades net R is negative → risk 0.25% per trade (quarter size) or stop trading and review strategy

performance_based_sizing.rationale: This is Ross Cameron's Profit Cushion applied to swing trading. Don't tighten stops when losing — tighten POSITION SIZE. Tight stops on volatile assets convert winners into losers. Smaller positions with proper stops protect capital while keeping win rate high.
performance_based_sizing.current_status: Check journal.json last 3-5 trades to determine current sizing tier before every briefing

position_sizing.formula: Position size = (Account x Risk%) / Stop distance (where stop distance = 1.5x ATR14 minimum)

stop_loss.never_exit_manually_before_stop: NEVER close a trade manually before the stop loss is hit. If you set a stop, let it work. Manual exits above the stop convert potential winners into guaranteed losers. (Lesson: SOL trade was right direction but manual exit at 82.26 lost $1.73 — price reached 86.83 two days later.)

atr_based_stops.description: Stop loss distance must respect the asset's natural volatility. Use ATR (Average True Range, 14-period) to calculate minimum stop distance. A stop tighter than 1x ATR will be hit by normal noise.
atr_based_stops.rule: Minimum stop distance = 1.5x ATR(14) on the entry timeframe
atr_based_stops.formula: Stop price (long) = Entry - (1.5 × ATR14). Stop price (short) = Entry + (1.5 × ATR14)
atr_based_stops.position_size_adjustment: When ATR requires a wider stop, REDUCE position size to maintain 1% risk. Position = (Portfolio × Risk%) ÷ (1.5 × ATR14)

typical_atr_by_asset.forex_majors: 50-100 pips on daily — stop minimum 75-150 pips
typical_atr_by_asset.oil_wti: $3-7 on daily — stop minimum $5-10 (NOT $2.80 like WTI trade #9)
typical_atr_by_asset.us_stocks: $2-8 on daily — stop minimum $3-12 depending on stock price

atr_based_stops.lesson: WTI trade #9 had a $2.80 stop on an asset with $10+ daily range. Stop was hit by normal noise even though direction was correct. With a $7 stop and smaller position, same 1% risk but trade would have survived.

placement_by_asset.forex: Below EMA 21 (longs) or above EMA 21 (shorts) — but never tighter than 1.5x ATR14
placement_by_asset.indices: 2-5% below EMA 50 — but never tighter than 1.5x ATR14
placement_by_asset.gold_silver: Below EMA 50 — minimum $60 distance on daily
placement_by_asset.oil: Below EMA 50 — minimum $5 distance on daily (oil is extremely volatile)
placement_by_asset.crypto_btc: Below EMA 55 or most recent weekly swing low — minimum $2000 distance
placement_by_asset.crypto_altcoins: Below EMA 50 or -5% from entry — whichever gives MORE room (not less)
placement_by_asset.us_stocks_daytrading: Below the low of the pullback candle — set BEFORE entry, never moved against you

stop_loss.trailing_stop_rule: Once trade reaches +1R profit — move stop to breakeven. Cannot lose on this trade. NOTE: breakeven stop is an EXIT strategy, not an ENTRY strategy. Set initial stop at proper ATR distance first.
stop_loss.order_expiry: Day only — cancel all unfilled orders end of trading session. No stale orders overnight.

take_profit.minimum_reward_to_risk: 2:1 — target at least 2x what you risk

preferred_by_asset.crypto_altcoins: 2:1 minimum — altcoins reverse fast, do not be greedy

methods.fibonacci: 1.618 extension of the prior swing move
methods.rsi_extreme: Exit when RSI hits 70+ on entry timeframe
methods.partial_exit: Take 50% profit at 1:1, move stop to breakeven, let rest run to full target

entry_filters.candle_confirmation: EMA crossover must be confirmed by CLOSE of candle — never enter mid-candle
entry_filters.higher_timeframe_alignment: Always check weekly trend before daily signal. Never trade against weekly tide.
entry_filters.news_blackout: No entries 30 minutes before or after major news releases

news_to_avoid: NFP — Non-Farm Payrolls (first Friday of month, 14:30 Oslo)
Fed Rate Decision (FOMC 8x per year, 20:00 Oslo)
ECB Rate Decision (14:15 Oslo on meeting days)
OPEC Meetings (oil only — can spike 3-5% instantly)

session_times_oslo.timezone: Norway — CET (UTC+1 winter) / CEST (UTC+2 summer April-October)
session_times_oslo.weekend_rule: Markets closed Sat-Sun (except crypto). First trade: Monday 10:00 Oslo.

trade_management.max_losses_before_pause: Stop after 3 consecutive losses. Review what went wrong.
trade_management.daily_loss_limit: Lose 3% of account in one day — stop for the day
trade_management.weekly_loss_limit: Lose 5% of account in one week — stop for the week
trade_management.no_revenge_trading: A loss is a cost of doing business. Never double size to recover.
trade_management.no_fomo: Missing a trade is better than forcing a bad entry. Another setup comes tomorrow.
trade_management.journal: Record every trade: asset, entry, stop, target, result, reason. Review weekly.
trade_management.scaling: Do not increase position size until 10+ consecutive profitable trades.

psychology_rules.think_in_R: 1R = your risk. 2R win = made 2x your risk. Think in R not dollars.
psychology_rules.discipline: Strategy is only as good as execution. Follow the rules exactly.
psychology_rules.patience: Most days there is NO good setup. Waiting is a valid action.
psychology_rules.detachment: Your self-worth is not your P&L. A losing trade does not make you a bad trader.
psychology_rules.front_side_only: Focus on first 20-30 minutes of a move. First spike + first 2 pullbacks = 80%+ of profit. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.inactivity_rule: If no trade taken in 30 minutes, walk away for the day. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.hot_vs_cold_markets: Hot days: trade longer and more aggressively. Cold days: walk away early even if below daily goal. Detach from fixed P&L targets. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.consecutive_discipline_days: Track how many days in a row you follow your rules, not how many days you profit. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.negative_feedback_loop: Loss → sadness → revenge trading → lower quality setups → more losses. Break it by starting small or walking away. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.decision_fatigue: The longer you sit, the worse your decisions. Walk away before fatigue sets in. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.standard_indicator_settings: NEVER use non-standard indicator settings. Use what everyone else uses so you see the same signals. The traffic light analogy. (Ross Cameron)
psychology_rules.never_exit_before_stop: NEVER close a trade manually before the stop loss is hit. If you set a stop at a level, trust it. Manual exits above the stop convert potential winners into guaranteed losses. (Lesson: SOL trade — exited at 82.26 for -$1.73, price reached 86.83 two days later = would have been +$5 win.)
psychology_rules.trust_the_atr_stop: When your stop is set at 1.5x ATR from entry, the price WILL fluctuate toward it. This is normal. Do not panic. The stop is designed to only get hit if the trend truly reverses, not by noise. (Lesson: WTI $2.80 stop on $10/day asset = noise kill.)
recommended_books: Quit by Annie Duke (knowing when to walk away)
Thinking in Bets by Annie Duke
The Happiness Advantage by Shawn Achor

risk_reward_ratio.description: Only enter a trade if potential profit is at least 2x the potential loss
risk_reward_ratio.example: If your stop loss is $2.50 away from entry, your take profit must be at least $5.00 away
risk_reward_ratio.when_to_check: BEFORE entering any trade — if the ratio is less than 1:2, do NOT enter

stop_loss_direction_rule.description: The stop loss may ONLY ever move TOWARD profit — never further away from entry
stop_loss_direction_rule.rule: Never move SL further from entry to avoid being stopped out — that is emotional trading and is forbidden
stop_loss_direction_rule.break_even_trigger: Once price moves 50% toward take profit, move SL up to at least break-even (entry price)
stop_loss_direction_rule.example_long: You buy at $100 with TP at $110. When price reaches $105 (50% toward TP), move SL to $100 (entry price)
stop_loss_direction_rule.violation: Moving SL DOWN on a long trade is forbidden — no exceptions

stop_loss_placement_support.description: Place SL below real support levels, not at round numbers
stop_loss_placement_support.step_1: Find a real support level on the chart — a price where the asset has bounced before
stop_loss_placement_support.step_2: Place SL just below that support level
stop_loss_placement_support.step_3: Add a buffer of $0.20–$0.50 below the support level to avoid normal price noise triggering the stop
stop_loss_placement_support.avoid: Do NOT place SL at round numbers like $80 or $85
stop_loss_placement_support.reason: Round numbers attract stop hunters who push price down to trigger stops before reversing

trailing_stop_loss.description: Automatically lock in profit as price rises without watching the screen constantly
trailing_stop_loss.activation: Once price has moved 50% of the way toward take profit, activate a trailing stop
trailing_stop_loss.direction_rule: Trailing stop only moves UPWARD for long trades — never back down
trailing_stop_loss.purpose: Locks in profit automatically while letting winners run further

short_trade_rules.description: Mirror of LONG rules for SHORT (sell) trades — same logic reversed

when_to_short.trend: Price is in a clear downtrend — lower highs and lower lows on Daily chart
when_to_short.entry_level: Price has bounced up to a resistance level and is starting to fall
when_to_short.entry: Sell at resistance level where price is starting to drop

short_trade_parameters.stop_loss: Above entry — if price rises above resistance, exit
short_trade_parameters.take_profit: Below entry at next support level

short_vs_long_differences.order_type: Sell Limit instead of Buy Limit
short_vs_long_differences.stop_loss_direction: ABOVE entry (price going up = losing on short)
short_vs_long_differences.take_profit_direction: BELOW entry (price going down = winning on short)
short_vs_long_differences.alerts: Entry = Crossing Down, Stop Loss = Crossing Up, Take Profit = Crossing Down

time_based_exit.description: Close trades that are going nowhere — do not let money sit in flat positions
time_based_exit.time_limit: 48 hours with no meaningful movement toward take profit
time_based_exit.meaningful_movement: Price must have moved at least 30% toward take profit within 48 hours
time_based_exit.action: If not — consider closing the trade
time_based_exit.reason: Money stuck in a flat trade is wasted capital that could be used elsewhere
time_based_exit.applies_especially_to: Crypto trades — these are expected to move quickly

watchlist_ranked_by_predictability.note: Ranked by how well price follows technical rules vs random sentiment

rank_2.reason: Strong technical trends. Clean S/R levels.

rank_3.reason: Carry trade dynamics. BOJ/Fed policy predictable.

rank_4.reason: Most liquid European index. Predictable session windows.

rank_5.reason: 30 mega-caps, less noise than SPY. Strong trending.

ai_ecosystem_watchlist.description: Complete AI revolution ecosystem — from chips to energy to raw materials. Scanned when relevant news appears. Built from Fidelity, BofA, Goldman Sachs research April 2026.

layer_1_chips_semiconductors.description: The brain of AI — chips and chip equipment. Highest direct AI exposure.

assets.name: NVIDIA
assets.why: Dominates AI GPU market. H100/H200 are the engine of every AI data center.

assets.name: AMD
assets.why: Main NVIDIA competitor. MI300X GPU gaining ground in AI workloads.

assets.name: Intel
assets.why: Rebuilding chip business. Foundry ambitions for US-made AI chips.

assets.name: Broadcom
assets.why: Custom ASICs for Google and Meta. $1.6T market cap. Goldman calls it 'AI arms dealer'.

assets.name: Qualcomm
assets.why: Edge AI chips for mobile and automotive. Growing AI inference market.

assets.name: Marvell Technology
assets.why: Custom AI chips and optical interconnects. Acquired Celestial AI Feb 2026.

assets.name: Applied Materials
assets.why: Makes equipment to manufacture chips. Every chip fab needs AMAT tools.

assets.name: ASML
assets.why: Monopoly on EUV lithography machines. No advanced chips without ASML.

assets.name: TSMC
assets.why: Manufactures 90% of world advanced chips. Makes NVIDIA, Apple, AMD chips.

assets.name: Lam Research
assets.why: Chip etching equipment. Critical for memory and logic chip production.

assets.name: KLA Corporation
assets.why: Chip inspection equipment. Quality control for every advanced semiconductor fab.

assets.name: Micron Technology
assets.why: HBM memory for AI GPUs. Every NVIDIA chip needs Micron HBM3 memory.

assets.name: Credo Technology
assets.why: High-speed copper links between GPUs. Revenue up 272% YoY in AI data centers.

assets.name: Alphabet/Google

assets.name: Meta

assets.name: Amazon
assets.why: AWS cloud dominates. Trainium chips. Nuclear deal with Talen Energy.

assets.name: Oracle
assets.why: AI cloud infrastructure. Signed massive GPU cluster deals with NVIDIA.

assets.name: CoreWeave
assets.why: Pure-play AI cloud. GPU rental for AI training. IPO 2025. Fast growing.

assets.name: Sterling Infrastructure

assets.name: Quanta Services

assets.name: Dominion Energy

assets.name: NextEra Energy

assets.name: Helium (via HCC)

scanning_priority_matrix.description: How I decide WHICH assets to scan in morning briefing
scanning_priority_matrix.step_1: Always scan session fixed assets (8 core assets)
scanning_priority_matrix.step_2: Search morning news for AI/tech/geo events
scanning_priority_matrix.step_3: Any news mentioning a layer_1 to layer_7 asset with >2% move — add to scan
scanning_priority_matrix.step_4: If earnings season (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) — check layer_2 hyperscalers for gaps
scanning_priority_matrix.step_5: Never scan more than 20 assets total per day — quality over quantity
scanning_priority_matrix.step_6: Pick 1 best trade per session (max 3 trades per day)
